summary: Completed testing of Iter 216h116 + 216h117 features: Personnel-rotation posting-out, Compliance calendar, MFA mandatory for MOD HQ, DIO contract stub, RIDDOR personal-incident workflow, and PWA offline-status pill. All 15 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend testing verified Classification Banner with right slot, but identified that MOD site users are routed to standard Pulse dashboard instead of MODSiteDashboard, making the incident wizard inaccessible.

The incident wizard needs to be integrated into LiteDashboardPage for MOD users.

success_rate.frontend: 70% - Classification Banner works, but incident wizard inaccessible

seed_data_creation: Called /api/mod/demo/seed-army-catterick to create Catterick Garrison hierarchy
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend features work correctly: (1) Posting-out handover records date and returns open_fault_count, (2) Compliance calendar CRUD works with status buckets, (3) MFA mandatory for mod_branch users - returns requires_mfa_enrolment + temp_token, (4) DIO contract stub works - escalation returns 409 without contact, 200 with contact, (5) RIDDOR incidents auto-flag hospitalised severity, (6) RIDDOR sweeper sends reminders for overdue followups. Frontend: Classification Banner with right slot works, OfflineStatusPill correctly hidden when online. ISSUE: MOD incident wizard is in MODSiteDashboard but users are routed to LiteDashboardPage.

posting_out_handover.details: POST /api/mod/site/staff/{id}/posting-out returns ok=true, posting_out_date, open_fault_count. Invalid dates rejected with 400. Sweeper auto-deactivates overdue postings.

compliance_calendar.details: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/mod/pro/compliance work correctly. Events have status buckets (overdue/critical/warning/soon/ok). Cross-scope access blocked with 403.

mfa_mandatory.details: MOD HQ login returns requires_mfa_enrolment + temp_token. /auth/mfa/enrol/setup returns provisioning_uri + secret + qrcode_data_url. /auth/mfa/enrol/complete with valid TOTP returns token + backup_codes.

dio_contract.details: PUT/GET /api/mod/pro/sites/{site_id}/dio-contract work. Escalation returns 409 without contact, 200 with escalated_to + contract_ref when set.

riddor_incidents.details: POST /api/mod/site/incidents with hospitalised severity auto-flags riddor_reportable=true, sets riddor_followup_at 7 days out. First-aid severity does NOT flag RIDDOR.

riddor_sweeper.details: Backdated riddor_followup_at triggers reminders_sent >= 1 and flips riddor_followup_sent=true.

classification_banner.details: Banner with '◆OFFICIAL◆' appears for MOD users. Right slot (mod-classification-right-slot) is present.

offline_status_pill.details: OfflineStatusPill correctly hidden when online with no pending items. Shows when offline or items queued.

incident_wizard_ui.details: MODIncidentWizard component exists with all required data-testids but is not accessible because MOD users are routed to LiteDashboardPage instead of MODSiteDashboard.

compliance_calendar_ui.details: Could not test because HQ user requires MFA enrolment which has no frontend UI. Backend API works correctly.
